learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to deeply observe everyday objects and use colors, light, and shadows to make them leap off the page in 3D!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A still life is an artwork focusing on objects that do not move, like a bowl of shiny fruit, a dusty old book, or a pair of worn-out sneakers. It trains you to see the hidden beauty in everyday things.
Objects are not just flat colors! To make an apple look round and real, you must paint the bright highlight where the light hits it, and the dark shadow hiding underneath it.

Great artists paint what they actually see, not what they think they know. If you look closely at a red apple, you will discover it actually has tiny hints of yellow, brown, and even purple in its skin!

fun_activity.title: 🔦 The Torchlight Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Place a favorite mug on a table in a dark room. Shine a flashlight on it from different angles to see how the highlights and shadows completely change its shape, then try doing a quick sketch!

quick_recap: ⭐ Still life art focuses on capturing the beauty and details of non-moving, inanimate objects.
⭐ Adding realistic highlights and deep shadows is the secret trick to making a flat drawing look 3D.
⭐ Careful observation is the most important skill an artist can develop to paint accurate colors and proportions.
